notes.title: Delivery of bundle "Trouble Witches Origin" DELUXE "Additional Character Pack" packed with four additional characters DLC!
notes.content:
We made four newly added characters, "Cynfi", "Louis", "Conon", "Raya" in one pack!


It is definitely profitable if you purchase all characters!


Caution!
If you buy a DLC included in the bundle, you can not purchase the bundle version.


 ■Store page

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5582/Trouble_Witches_Origin_DELUXE_Additional_Character_Pack/

notes.title: Distribution of additional characters started! & Version 1.12 Update Notic
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24557393/8171ed5bc7d6783ab98d1c95d4a7bc3b963bd185.jpg

Thank you for waiting!!

From today, "Trouble Witches Origin - Episode1 Daughters of Amalgam - " will finally start delivering DLC, "Cynfi", "Louis", "Conon", "Raya", for additional characters!

Use the power-up 4 people, aim for further score up!!

The bundle which packed four characters also started distribution.
http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5582/Trouble_Witches_Origin_DELUXE_Additional_Character_Pack

Caution!
If you buy a DLC included in the bundle, you can not purchase the bundle version.

Also, with this DLC distribution, Ver1.12 was released.

Changes in version 1.12

■Revamped "Leader Board" with additional character implementation

■Some bug fixes
